name: miniconda-python-env
description: Standardize Python execution via Miniconda envs (A/B/C scenarios + strict cleanup rules + conda-first deps). Self-configuring on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Every Python task gets its own isolated Miniconda env, with strict cleanup and conda-first deps.
interface.longDescription: Standardizes how AI agents use Python on this Windows machine: every Python task gets its own isolated Miniconda env, auto-classified as A (temp, deleted after task), B (standalone keeper), or C (project-internal). Enforces conda-first dependency installs (pip only as fallback), strict cleanup scope, environment.yml generation for kept envs, and chains into the sister skill windows-tools-install-manager if Miniconda is missing.
defaultPrompt: 用 Python 处理这堆 CSV
